SELECT object_type, bucket, COUNT(*) AS n_clusters, SUM(usable) AS n_members, SUM(raw - usable) AS n_excluded FROM ( SELECT object_type, CASE WHEN usable = 0 THEN 'empty' WHEN usable = 1 THEN '1' WHEN usable = 2 THEN '2' WHEN usable = 3 THEN '3' WHEN usable <= 5 THEN '4-5' WHEN usable <= 10 THEN '6-10' WHEN usable <= 50 THEN '11-50' ELSE '51+' END AS bucket, usable, raw FROM ( SELECT c.object_type AS object_type, COUNT(*) AS raw, SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS usable FROM concept_clusters c LEFT JOIN knowledge_objects o ON o.id = c.member_object_id AND o.notebook_id = c.notebook_id AND o.status IN (%s,%s,%s,%s) WHERE c.notebook_id = %s AND c.generation = COALESCE((SELECT cluster_generation FROM unified_kg_state WHERE notebook_id = %s), 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_objects xo WHERE xo.id = c.member_object_id AND xo.notebook_id = c.notebook_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources ds WHERE ds.id = xo.source_id AND ds.notebook_id = xo.notebook_id AND ds.source_type = 'memory')) GROUP BY c.object_type, c.canonical_id ) g ) b GROUP BY object_type, bucket

SELECT c.canonical_id AS canonical_id, COALESCE(MIN(NULLIF(c.canonical_name, '')), '') AS canonical_name, COUNT(o.id) AS members FROM concept_clusters c JOIN knowledge_objects o ON o.id = c.member_object_id AND o.notebook_id = c.notebook_id AND o.status IN (%s,%s,%s,%s) WHERE c.notebook_id = %s AND c.object_type = 'concept' AND c.generation = COALESCE((SELECT cluster_generation FROM unified_kg_state WHERE notebook_id = %s), 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources ds WHERE ds.id = o.source_id AND ds.notebook_id = o.notebook_id AND ds.source_type = 'memory') GROUP BY c.canonical_id ORDER BY members DESC, c.canonical_id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT %s

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b0, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b3, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b4, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b5, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket = %s) AS b6, min(bucket) FILTER (WHERE NOT (bucket = ANY(%s))) AS unknown_bucket FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN rs = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN bad THEN 'endpoint_unusable' WHEN tag = 'relink:shared-element' THEN 'relink:shared-element' WHEN tag = 'relink:name-match' THEN 'relink:name-match' WHEN tag LIKE 'relink:%%' THEN 'relink:other' WHEN COALESCE(tag, '') != '' THEN 'tagged:other' ELSE 'untagged' END AS bucket FROM ( SELECT r.review_status AS rs, (s.id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL) AS bad, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.evidence -> 0) = 'object' THEN r.evidence -> 0 ->> 'basis' END AS tag FROM knowledge_relations r LEFT JOIN knowledge_objects s ON s.id = r.source_object_id AND s.notebook_id = r.notebook_id AND s.status IN (%s,%s,%s,%s) LEFT JOIN knowledge_objects t ON t.id = r.target_object_id AND t.notebook_id = r.notebook_id AND t.status IN (%s,%s,%s,%s) WHERE r.notebook_id = %s AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources ds WHERE ds.id = r.source_id AND ds.notebook_id = r.notebook_id AND ds.source_type = 'memory') ) y ) x
